witness.statement:
∀ (σ : ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Context),
  σ.WellFormed →
    instLENat.le 4 σ.a →
      instLENat.le 4 σ.u →
        instLENat.le 2 σ.numRuns →
          instLENat.le 2 σ.bound →
            Exists fun p =>
              And (List.instMembership.mem σ.childPositions p)
                (Exists fun s =>
                  Exists fun c =>
                    And (instLENat.le 1 c)
                      (And (instLENat.le c (instHSub.hSub σ.k 2))
                        (Eq σ.bound
                          (instHAdd.hAdd (σ.part (List.cons p List.nil) s c).bound
                            (σ.part
                                (List.filter (fun q => Decidable.decide (Ne q p)) σ.childPositions)
                                (ErdosSzekeres.ctx_bound_attained_by_singleton_cut.match_1
                                  (fun s => ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side) s
                                  (fun _ => ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side.upper) fun _ =>
                                  ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side.lower)
                                (instHSub.hSub (instHSub.hSub σ.k 1) c)).bound))))
